items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: Well, that's what I'm talking about. King Swayze. ... But I said King Porter, didn't he? Yeah. No, King Swayze, tall, slender boy. Yeah, not too honest.

ctx.x: Yeah. Did you ever know a trumpet player? I think he was from, well, he played around Texas. His name was King Swayze.
Well, that's what I'm talking about. King Swayze.
